dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: This... this is incredible! We need to relay the humans' message with the rest of the colony!

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: Yeah! Um! Question, if I may Commander-

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: - how do we intend to contact the rest of the colony once they replace you with another Commander?

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: WHAT?! Replace me? Why'd they replace me?!

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Well, you technically haven't been doing your job by standing out here with us.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: So they probably already sent in a replacement <color=#c21613>Commander<color=#ffffff>, Commander.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: So I guess you aren't the commander anymore.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Fine, right... instead, you can call me...

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: <color=#c21613>M-Major<color=#ffffff>! Yes, <color=#c21613>Major<color=#ffffff> of the <color=#12b518>Temp-OS<color=#ffffff>!

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Wow! Creative! I want a new name! I'll be <color=#6213c2>Chromatic<color=#ffffff>!

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Rolls off the metaphorical tongue. <color=#6213c2>Chrrrrrromatic<color=#ffffff>!

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: Oh! Oh new names! I - new names!

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: I'm gonna be <color=#c2ab13>Trill!<color=#ffffff> The term for when you make a rapid, high pitched-

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Nice everybody, I love the spirit! Lifter?

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Uh. <color=#1399c2>Flat<color=#ffffff>. Because I'm not too sharp.

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Hm! Awful use of punwork!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Alright everybody, then we are <color=#6213c2>Chromatic<color=#ffffff>, <color=#c2ab13>Trill<color=#ffffff>, <color=#1399c2>Flat<color=#ffffff>, and <color=#c21613>Major<color=#ffffff> of <color=#12b518>Temp-OS<color=#ffffff>!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Our new directive is to relay this message from the humans to the colony. No matter how long it takes!

dialogue.name: ALL
dialogue.text: Yeah!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: As your Commander… As your Major, I assign this directive Project Overture!
PROJECT OVERTURE.
